items.docs: Creates a new Vagrant box under the authenticated user or specified organization. Requires authentication with a valid access token.

params.name: username
params.description: The username or organization name that owns the box.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the Vagrant box.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Vagrant box, including its versions, providers, and metadata. Public boxes do not require authentication.

params.name: username
params.description: The username or organization name that owns the box.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the Vagrant box.

items.docs: Updates the metadata of an existing Vagrant box, such as its description, short description, or privacy settings.

params.name: username
params.description: The username or organization name that owns the box.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the Vagrant box.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a Vagrant box and all of its versions and providers. This action cannot be undone.

params.name: registry
params.description: The globally unique name of the Vagrant box registry such as hashicorp in hashicorp/vagrant.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: page_token
params.description: The token for fetching the next page of results.

items.docs: Lists all Vagrant boxes within a specific registry. Supports pagination for registries with many boxes.

params.name: registry
params.description: The globally unique name of the Vagrant box registry such as hashicorp in hashicorp/vagrant.

items.docs: Creates a new Vagrant box within a registry. The box name must be unique within the registry and should only be set at creation time.

params.name: registry
params.description: The globally unique name of the Vagrant box registry such as hashicorp in hashicorp/vagrant.

params.name: box
params.description: The name segment of the box which is unique within the registry.

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Vagrant box within a registry.

params.name: registry
params.description: The globally unique name of the Vagrant box registry such as hashicorp in hashicorp/vagrant.

params.name: box
params.description: The name segment of the box which is unique within the registry.

items.docs: Updates the metadata of an existing Vagrant box within a registry, such as its descriptions.

params.name: registry
params.description: The globally unique name of the Vagrant box registry such as hashicorp in hashicorp/vagrant.

params.name: box
params.description: The name segment of the box which is unique within the registry.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a box and all of its versions and providers from the registry. This action cannot be undone.
